mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS decline are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 5.0% signals a deteriorating labor market that increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) both decline over the past 3 months, it signals a weakening economy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 60% of triggered instances (both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5% and the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, it signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL 12m change > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST below 1900.0 signals a weak housing market that increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 60% of triggered instances despite HOUST < 1900.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A RSAFS above 350000.0 signals strong consumer demand that increases corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
